description: Save/overwrite the full Lovelace configuration of a dashboard. Provide the complete config with views and cards.

config.description: Full Lovelace configuration object with 'views' array. Example: { views: [{ title: 'Home', cards: [...] }] }

url_path.description: Dashboard URL path (e.g. 'tablet'). Omit for default dashboard.

name: ha_save_dashboard_config
